name: ggc-reports-ci
description: Sitio estático en GitHub Pages que acumula informes de rendimiento generados con [Unlighthouse](https://unlighthouse.dev/) (Lighthouse) vía GitHub Actions.

scripts.audit:elespanol: node scripts/accept-cookies.js https://www.elespanol.com && npx @unlighthouse/cli unlighthouse-ci --config-file unlighthouse-elespanol.config.ts --build-static --output-path reports/elespanol.com/local
